supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the temporal margin of the orbit, creating a distinct shelf over the eye.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast visible; the muzzle area is lightly pigmented (pale/pinkish) compared to the dark, high-melanin periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick 2D vertical profile of the lower lip with a notable structural droop.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of dark, irregular spots (freckling) on the light-pigmented muzzle and prominent concentric skin folds in the infraorbital region.
